segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Ben with Northlake Design Group. Email is ben.morris@northlakedg.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks, Ben. I found the account. What can I help with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need to add 4 seats before Monday. We have 28 now, and I want to bring it to 32. Same plan, same billing contact.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m in the admin console now. The account is on the Business plan, billed monthly, renewal on the 12th. Adding 4 seats will prorate for the current cycle at $86.40 total before tax. Does that look okay?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s fine. Can you make them available right away?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. I’ve added the 4 seats, so you should see 32 total seats now. The billing tool generated invoice 41872 for the prorated amount, and it’ll go to ap@northlakedg.com.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. I’m refreshing, yeah, I see 32. That’s all I needed.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. I’ll note ticket 263914 as completed. You’re all set.
